unit.why: A single narrative: the Alter Rebbe saw the Ari appear and converse with the Maggid of Mezritch during a teaching; R. Pinhas of Korets asked who it was.

stories.summary_en: The author of the Tanya told that while the Maggid of Mezritch was teaching Hasidism in deep detachment, he stopped for half an hour and spoke with a man in worldly clothes. When R. Pinhas of Korets asked who the man was, the Maggid answered that he was the Ari.
